title: Sensory processing and executive functioning interaction in neurodevelopmental disorders and at-risk conditions: A systematic review and meta-analysis
title_zh: 神经发育障碍与高危条件下感官处理与执行功能的相互作用：系统综述与荟萃分析
abstract: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the relationship between sensory processing (SP) and executive functioning (EF) in children and adolescents (ages 0-18) diagnosed with neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs) or at-risk conditions, such as prematurity and genetic syndromes. Adhering to PRISMA guidelines, the results of 30 peer-reviewed studies were analyzed by qualitative and quantitative analyses to evaluate the strength and nature of these associations. The findings revealed a consistent and significant correlation between SP and EF, with effect sizes (r) ranging from r = .19 to r = .77. Meta-analytic synthesis confirmed a medium effect size (d =.58). While substantial heterogeneity was observed (I^2 = 82.9%), it was not moderated by the specific diagnosis of NDDs, age, EF component or correlation adjustment status. Notably, assessment modality served as a significant moderator: performance-based measures demonstrated higher associative strength and lower heterogeneity compared to questionnaire-based or combined assessment. Regression models indicated that SP measures statistically accounted for a substantial portion of EF variance (28-71%), while comparative analyses showed moderate-to-large differences in EF performance (η² =.10-.34) between typical and atypical sensory profiles. Furthermore, mediation analyses suggested significant indirect associations involving EF, particularly emotion regulation and inhibitory control, in the relationship between sensory processing and adaptive and functional outcomes. The evidence underscores a robust interdependence between sensory processing and executive functions in clinical and at-risk pediatric populations. These findings highlight the potential relevance of considering both sensory and executive domains in assessment and intervention planning.
abstract_zh: 本系统综述与荟萃分析研究了感官处理（SP）与执行功能（EF）在患有神经发育障碍（NDDs）或高危条件（如早产和遗传综合征）的儿童与青少年（0-18岁）中的关系。遵循PRISMA指南，对30项同行评议研究的结果进行了定性和定量分析，以评估这些关联的强度和性质。结果显示，SP与EF之间存在一致且显著的相关性，相关系数（r）范围从0.19到0.77。荟萃分析确认中等效应量（d = 0.58）。尽管观察到显著异质性（I² = 82.9%），但该异质性并未受到NDDs具体诊断、年龄、EF组成部分或相关性调整状态的调节。值得注意的是，评估方式是一个显著的调节变量：基于表现的测量显示出更高的关联强度和更低的异质性，而基于问卷或组合评估则相对较低。回归模型表明，SP测量在统计上解释了EF方差的相当大部分（28-71%），而比较分析显示典型与非典型感官特征之间的EF表现存在中等至大差异（η² = 0.10-0.34）。此外，调解分析提示在感官处理与适应性及功能性结果之间的关系中，EF（尤其是情绪调节和抑制控制）存在显著的间接关联。证据强调了感官处理与执行功能在临床和高危儿童人群中的强烈相互依赖性。这些发现突显了在评估和干预规划中同时考虑感官与执行领域的潜在重要性。
